title: Verification-Failure Incident Composer
description: Composes and signs (eddsa-jcs-2022, ephemeral did:key) a verification-failure incident record from session context, an OCG Standard section 22.9 AR4SI-tiered failure classification, and an escalation target, for fraud teams, regulators, or insurers. Attests the declared record only, never detection quality.

verifier_identity.description: Verifier identity and version, as declared by the composing party

session_id.description: Session identifier the incident is about

session_receipt_digest.description: Optional execution_hash of an IS-1 session receipt, if one exists

failing_rule_id.description: Identifier of the rule or check that failed

tier.description: AR4SI trustworthiness tier: affirming, warning, or contraindicated

description.description: Failure description as declared by the composing party

incident.description: Signed verification-failure incident record with eddsa-jcs-2022 proof

receipt.description: OCG receipt of the composing activity with execution_hash

mcp_tool_definition.name: compose_verification_failure_incident
mcp_tool_definition.description: Composes and signs a verification-failure incident record (OCG Standard section 22.9 AR4SI-tiered) from session context, a failure classification, and an escalation target (fraud team, regulator, or insurer). Attests the declared record only, never detection quality or subject identity. Browser-based, client-side only. Zero PII. Link users to https://ainumbers.co/tools/549-verification-failure-incident-composer.html for interactive use.
